annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部办公厅 (General Office of the Ministry of Transport of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to autonomous vehicles in urban bus, taxi, passenger and freight transport; operation only in designated areas after road traffic safety assessment.
Autonomous transport of dangerous goods is prohibited.
Safety officers required in vehicles; remote safety officers allowed for fully autonomous taxis at a ratio of at least 1:3 with city approval.
Operators must have safety management systems, safety plans, risk assessments, emergency plans and carrier liability insurance.
Vehicles must record at least 90 seconds of pre-incident data, display autonomous status markings, and report operations to authorities.
named_instruments_referenced: Road Traffic Safety Law of China
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Transport trial guideline (Jiao Ban Yun [2023] No. 66) governing the use of autonomous vehicles in bus, taxi, passenger and freight transport. It sets permitted scenarios, operator and vehicle requirements, safety-officer staffing, safety management, data recording, emergency response and supervision, and bans dangerous-goods transport.
